principle_violations.reason: The Order class is responsible for managing order details and also handling payment processing, violating the Single Responsibility Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the payment processing logic into a dedicated PaymentProcessor class to adhere to the Single Responsibility Principle.

suggestion_code:
class PaymentProcessor:
    def __init__(self, order):
        self.order = order

    def pay(self, payment_type: str, security_code):
        if payment_type == "debit":
            print("Processing debit payment type")
            print(f"Verifying security code: {security_code}")
            self.order.status = "paid"
        elif payment_type == "credit":
            print("Processing credit payment type")
            print(f"Verifying security code: {security_code}")
            self.order.status = "paid"
        else:
            raise Exception(f"Unknown payment type: {payment_type}")

order = Order()
payment_processor = PaymentProcessor(order)
order.add_item("Keyboard", 1, 50)
order.add_item("SSD", 1, 150)
order.add_item("USB cable", 2, 5)
print(order.total_price())
payment_processor.pay("debit", "0372846")
